_README: Giggora — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Every other config file is GENERATED from this one by scripts/gen-config.mjs. Never hand-edit genesis/qbftConfigFile.json or .env; edit this file and re-run `bash scripts/create-genesis.sh`. See docs/configuration.md.
_WHY_JSON_NOT_YAML: The brief suggested chain.yaml. JSON is used instead so the generator needs zero npm dependencies and can run before any install step — a YAML parser would mean `npm install` must succeed before the chain can boot. Field documentation lives in docs/configuration.md.

devnet.description: Local docker-compose network. Uses PUBLICLY KNOWN keys. Never carries value.

testnet.description: Public testnet. Phase 8. Requires a real key ceremony.

mainnet.description: RESERVED. Not launched. Requires legal review and independent validators.

consensus._validatorCountNote: QBFT is n = 3f + 1. 4 validators tolerate 1 faulty node. 3 would tolerate 0.
consensus._blockRewardNote: Wei per block. 0 = pre-mine only. Raise later via the `transitions` genesis section, no hard fork needed.

genesis._fixedBaseFeeNote: REQUIRED, and load-bearing. Without it the EIP-1559 base fee decays ~12.5% per empty block. On an idle chain it falls below min-gas-price (1 gwei), and since eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas returns 0 here, wallets estimate a maxFeePerGas UNDER the node's floor. Transactions are then accepted into the pool and silently never mined — MetaMask just hangs. fixedBaseFee pins the base fee at baseFeePerGas forever, so base fee == min gas price and estimation always clears the floor. Preferred over zeroBaseFee, which would make gas free and the chain trivially spammable.
genesis._hardforkNote: Cancun is required in practice: OpenZeppelin 5.6.x emits mcopy (a Cancun opcode) in utils/Bytes.sol, so a Shanghai-only chain cannot compile current OpenZeppelin at all. Cancun on a non-PoS chain works ONLY because the EIP-4788 beacon-roots contract is pre-deployed below; without it Besu makes a system call to an empty address and logs 'Invalid system call address' every block. Set this back to 'shanghai' to fall back (contracts would then need OpenZeppelin <=5.1 and evm_version='shanghai').

beaconRoots._note: EIP-4788 beacon roots contract, runtime bytecode (97 bytes, init prefix 60618060095f395ff3 stripped). Cancun performs a system call here every block. Giggora has no beacon chain, but the contract must still EXIST. Pre-deploying it in genesis is the documented fix for private networks. Zero balance: does not affect total supply.

gas._minGasPriceNote: 1 gwei. Deliberately NOT zero — a zero-gas chain is trivially spammable.

supply._totalNote: 1,000,000,000 GIG. The generator asserts the allocations below sum to exactly this.

database.name: giggora
database._passwordNote: DEVNET ONLY, and deliberately not a secret — the same reasoning as the publicly-known devnet signing keys. Postgres is bound to 127.0.0.1 and never exposed publicly (brief §32). For testnet/mainnet, override POSTGRES_PASSWORD from a real secret store and never commit it (brief §30).
database._hostPortNote: 5433 on the host to avoid clashing with a local Postgres install; 5432 inside the network.

ports._validatorDebugNote: Validator RPC ports are bound to 127.0.0.1 only, for devnet debugging. In production validators expose nothing.

docker._besuImageNote: Pinned. Verified on Docker Hub 2026-09-07. Do not use :latest — consensus config must be reproducible.

network._note: Static IPs are REQUIRED, not cosmetic. Besu rejects an enode URL whose host is a DNS name ('Invalid ip address'), so the bootnode must be reachable at a fixed IP. validator-N = validatorIpPrefix + (validatorIpStart + N - 1).
